title: Dot product as a sum over the support
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $\gamma,x\in\bbr_2^n$. The dot product of $\gamma$ and $x$ equals the sum of the coordinates of $x$ at precisely those indices where $\gamma$ is nonzero, with the sum taken in $\bbr_2$.
